name: frameTop
doc: Frame symbols along the top row (y 0), one per column.

name: frameMiddleRow
doc: Frame symbols of the separator rows of the credits and the 3D view frame.

name: frameBottom
doc: Frame symbols along row 23.

name: frameLeft
doc: Frame symbols down the left column (x 0).

name: frameRight
doc: Frame symbols down the right column (x 39).

name: recolourFrom
doc: The colours recolouring maps from (identity).

name: recolourCombat
doc: Combat pictures (COMSPR and the area's own icons) recoloured to.

name: recolourIcon
doc: The ICON pictures recoloured to (colour 13 becomes 0).

name: wildMapCursorX
doc: Wilderness map cursor columns (8-pixel cells), by place.

name: wildMapCursorY
doc: Wilderness map cursor rows (8-pixel cells), by place.

name: raceNames
doc: Race names: monster, dwarf, elf, gnome, half-elf, halfling, half-orc, human.

name: genderNames
doc: Gender names.

name: classNames
doc: Class names; 8.. are the multi-class combinations.

name: alignmentNames
doc: Alignment names.

name: coinNames
doc: Coin names: copper .. jewelry.

name: statusNames
doc: Character status names (Status).

name: itemWords
doc: The words item names are made of (entry 0 unused).

name: defaultIconColours
doc: Combat icon colours of a new character, one per icon part.

name: raceClasses
doc: Per race: the number of classes it may take, then those classes.

name: classAlignments
doc: Per class: the number of alignments it allows, then those alignments.

name: thac0Table
doc: Per class and level (0..12): the THAC0 base value.

name: classItemFlags
doc: Per class: the item-use bits it adds to the class mask.

name: raceAges
doc: Per race, for the classes 0..6: starting age base (word), dice count, dice sides.

name: ageSteps
doc: Per race: the ages at which abilities change (four steps, one spare word).

name: raceStatLimits
doc: Per race: strength min/max by gender, exceptional strength max by gender, then min/max of int wis dex con cha.

name: classStatMinimum
doc: Per class: the minimum of each ability (str int wis dex con cha).

name: classHitDice
doc: Per class: dice count and sides of the starting hit points.

name: coinValues
doc: Worth of copper, silver, electrum, gold and platinum, in copper.

name: classExpMasks
doc: Per class: the training bit of the class (trainers list the bits they train).

name: classMaxHitDice
doc: Per class: the level up to which hit points are rolled.

name: classHitDiceFirst
doc: Per class: hit dice rolled at level 1.

name: classHitDiceSides
doc: Per class: sides of the hit dice.

name: conHitPointBonus
doc: Per constitution score: the hit point bonus per die.

name: expTableData
doc: Per class (99-byte rows): longint experience thresholds; level n needs the one at index n+1.

name: clericSlotData
doc: Cleric spells gained per level: entry level*5 + spell level (1..5).

name: paladinSlotData
doc: Paladin cleric spells gained per level: entry level*5 + spell level.

name: rangerSlotData
doc: Ranger spells gained per level: entry level*5 + k (k 1..3 druid, 4..5 magic-user).

name: mageSlotData
doc: Magic-user spells gained per level: entry level*5 + spell level.

name: saveTableData
doc: Saving throw targets: entry class*60 + level*5 + save.

name: oldClassSaveData
doc: Saving throws by the old-class level column: entry level*5 + save.

name: thiefBaseData
doc: Thief skills by level: entry level*8 + skill (1..8).

name: thiefRaceDexData
doc: Thief skill adjustment by race (thiefRaceData: entry race*8 + skill) and, overlapping it from +19, by dexterity (thiefDexData: entry dex*5 + skill 1..5).

name: skyColours
doc: The sky colour by the area's sky word.

name: viewFrameTop
doc: Symbols of the 3D view frame's top row, columns 2..14.

name: viewFrameBottom
doc: Symbols of the 3D view frame's bottom row, columns 2..14.

name: viewFrameLeft
doc: Symbols of the 3D view frame's left column, rows 2..14.

name: viewFrameRight
doc: Symbols of the 3D view frame's right column, rows 2..14.

name: viewDivider
doc: Symbols of the column-16 rule beside the view, rows 0..16.

name: directionNames
doc: Compass point names by facing 0..7.

name: stepX
doc: Column step by facing 0..7 (8: none).

name: stepY
doc: Row step by facing 0..7 (8: none).

name: combatFrameLeft
doc: Combat screen frame symbols down column 0 (rows 0..22).

name: combatFrameMiddle
doc: Combat screen frame symbols down column 22, between the map and the panel.

name: combatFrameRight
doc: Combat screen frame symbols down column 39.

name: groundInfo
doc: Combat ground tiles: move cost (255 blocks), two flags and the tile's kind.

name: footprints
doc: Squares a combatant of size 0..4 covers: column and row offsets of its four parts (-1 none).

name: teamSides
doc: Formation: the side each of the four teams of a facing looks to.

name: teamDirs
doc: Formation: each team's direction (times 2) for the facing.

name: combatFacings
doc: Combat facing for the party's map facing / 2.

name: formationStartX
doc: Formation start column: first team / other teams, by direction.

name: formationStartY
doc: Formation start row: first team / other teams, by direction.

name: formationRows
doc: Formation slots: per direction (4: the second team), rows 0..5 of first and last column.

name: itemTemplates
doc: Magic item templates read by the treasure generator: from entry n, name words n..n+2, weight n+3, price n+4, spells n+5..n+7 (low bytes).

name: diseaseAffects
doc: The affects a paladin's Cure removes (diseases).

name: clockLimits
doc: Clock carries: minutes per ten, tens per hour, hours per day ... (area words 198..204).

name: helplessAffectData
doc: Entries 1..4: the affects that leave a character helpless.

name: downAffectData
doc: Entries 1..19: the affects a character loses when it goes out of action (O0E3:15AB).

name: cloudSquares4
doc: The facings from a small cloud's centre to its 4 squares (stinking cloud).

name: dispelCloudSquares
doc:
The squares Dispel Magic tries for a cloud: DS:27D9 read from entry 1,
the small cloud's table running on into the next, also for the large
cloud (O0C2:31E4).

name: cloudSquares9
doc: The facings from a large cloud's centre to its 9 squares (cloudkill); 8 is the centre.

name: fightAffectData
doc: Entries 1..4: the affects that end with the fight (O0E3:160D).

name: spellNames
doc: Spell names by spell number.

name: spellLevelHeadings
doc: Spell menu headings by spell level.

name: spellTableData
doc: The spell table: one 16-byte record per spell number (spellEntry).

name: turnUndeadRolls
doc:
turnUndeadRolls = DS:0369 + 10*undead + column: the d20 a cleric needs to
turn undead of each row (1..10), by cleric column (levels 1..8, 9..13,
14 and up). 0: turned automatically, negative: destroyed (needing its
absolute value), 99: impossible.

name: wildTerrainFlags
doc:
wildTerrainFlags = DS:0354: the wilderness terrain flags (terrainSparse
...) by area byte 0x342.

name: aiStepTurns
doc:
aiStepTurns = DS:02B8: for move pattern p (1..6) and try i (1..5), the
turn from the wanted direction at aiStepTurns[p*5+i]. The first bytes
are other data; pattern 0 never occurs.

name: heldAffects
doc:
heldAffects (DS:0A46, entries 1..4 of DS:0A45): the affects of holding and being held (releaseHeld);
TestHeldAffects names them.
